newsitem.title: USA: Valley Nat'l buys gas and welding supply co.
newsitem.headline: Valley Nat'l buys gas and welding supply co.

text.p: Valley National Gases Inc said Monday it had acquired Doansco Inc, an industrial gas and welding supply distributor located in Hamilton, Ohio, with annualized sales of about $2 million.
The company did not disclose the terms of the deal but said it had financed the acquisition with a combination of cash, borrowings under its credit facility and notes with the seller.
It said it expects to release results for the fourth quarter and year ended June 30 on August 4.
